REQ-001.source: ** — The Root runtime compatibility identity shall denote one compatibility epoch of consequential generic daemon/client contract semantics.
REQ-001.destination: ** — The generic runtime compatibility identity shall denote one compatibility epoch of consequential generic daemon/client contract semantics.

REQ-003.source: ** — Root shall own the identity and its semantic definition under O-11. A Tier-0 relationship act may coordinate Flow-A but shall not transfer ownership of generic runtime semantics.
REQ-003.destination: ** — The runtime project shall own the identity and its semantic definition under the approved ownership overlay to O-11. A Tier-0 relationship act may coordinate Flow-A but shall not transfer ownership of generic runtime semantics.

REQ-008.source: ** — Changing the compatibility identity shall require a consequential Root tranche under this deliverable, client-impact determination, separately governed affected-client conformance or migration, regression evidence, and a separate accountable-human release disposition.
REQ-008.destination: ** — Changing the compatibility identity shall require a consequential runtime-project tranche under this deliverable, client-impact determination, separately governed affected-client conformance or migration, regression evidence, and a separate accountable-human release disposition.

REQ-009.source: ** — A client shall be classified as affected only when it has an accepted implementation or migration obligation for the exact Root change. Naming a prospective client shall not create work, a closure veto, or a PEC obligation.
REQ-009.destination: ** — A client shall be classified as affected only when it has an accepted implementation or migration obligation for the exact runtime-project change. Naming a prospective client shall not create work, a closure veto, or a PEC obligation.

REQ-015.source: ** — Root shall define the generic floor. Each actually affected client shall own its client-specific retained-function, presentation, migration, and conformance evidence under its own accepted scope and gates.
REQ-015.destination: ** — The runtime project shall define the generic floor. Each actually affected client shall own its client-specific retained-function, presentation, migration, and conformance evidence under its own accepted scope and gates.

REQ-016.source: ** — PEC v2 shall receive no obligation until a separate PEC gate establishes an active accepted v2 carrier and an exact affected operation. Frozen PEC v0.4 shall remain reference evidence only.
REQ-016.destination: ** — PEC v2 shall receive no obligation until a separate PEC gate establishes an active accepted v2 carrier and an exact affected operation. Frozen PEC v0.4 shall remain reference evidence only. Boundary-owner allocation: CLM-006.

REQ-027.source: ** — The first activation shall use Context Envelope M and shall be limited to exact specification, read-only consumer inventory, evidence-matrix design, and change planning. It shall not write implementation bytes.
REQ-027.destination: ** — The first activation shall use Context Envelope M and shall be limited to exact specification, read-only consumer inventory, evidence-matrix design, and change planning. It shall not write implementation bytes. Boundary-owner allocation: CLM-006.

REQ-032.source: ** — App, PEC, Tier-0, Piping, and any other client or coordination surface shall remain under its own authority. Client writes require separately accepted client-owned tranches; Tier-0 coordination cannot amend Root semantics.
REQ-032.destination: ** — App, PEC, Tier-0, Piping, and any other client or coordination surface shall remain under its own authority. Client writes require separately accepted client-owned tranches; Tier-0 coordination cannot amend generic runtime semantics. Boundary-owner allocation: CLM-006.

REQ-035.source: ** — Consequential implementation, client migration, contract repinning, lifecycle transition, public export, release, publication, issuance, and professional reliance shall each remain behind their named later human gate.
REQ-035.destination: ** — Consequential implementation, client migration, contract repinning, lifecycle transition, public export, release, publication, issuance, and professional reliance shall each remain behind their named later human gate. Boundary-owner allocation: CLM-006.

REQ-037.source: ** — Final release fan-in shall include exact compatibility and degraded-mode contracts, actual affected-client disposition, Root regression evidence, accepted affected-client evidence, Tier-0 relationship disposition, notice state, rollback and indeterminate-operation treatment, and accountable-human release disposition.
REQ-037.destination: ** — Final release fan-in shall include exact compatibility and degraded-mode contracts, actual affected-client disposition, runtime-project regression evidence, accepted affected-client evidence, Tier-0 relationship disposition, notice state, rollback and indeterminate-operation treatment, and accountable-human release disposition.

REQ-040.source: ** — Public export may include generic runtime, CLI, contracts, and safe adapters only after applicable gates and evidence pass; credentials, machine state, downloaded models, and private project adapters or evidence shall remain excluded.
REQ-040.destination: ** — Public export may include generic runtime, CLI, contracts, and safe adapters only after applicable gates and evidence pass; credentials, machine state, downloaded models, and private project adapters or evidence shall remain excluded. Boundary-owner allocation: CLM-006.

REQ-041.source: ** — Electron daemon mode shall preserve the existing packaged-App identity and encrypted `safeStorage` credential boundary as single-owner; no client tranche may repartition credential custody by implication.
REQ-041.destination: ** — Electron daemon mode shall preserve the existing packaged-App identity and encrypted `safeStorage` credential boundary as single-owner; no client tranche may repartition credential custody by implication. Boundary-owner allocation: CLM-006.

REQ-043.source: ** — Agent 0, Agent 1, and Agent 2 shall remain authority and responsibility contracts independent of engine or model; Agent 2 shall not delegate, and actual model attribution shall not become durable role doctrine.
REQ-043.destination: ** — Agent 0, Agent 1, and Agent 2 shall remain authority and responsibility contracts independent of engine or model; Agent 2 shall not delegate, and actual model attribution shall not become durable role doctrine. Boundary-owner allocation: CLM-006.

REQ-044.source: ** — Local-model activation shall remain explicit with no automatic load, unload, switch, alias, or fallback; residency transitions shall remain evidence-bearing and epoch-bound, and unknown helper models shall not be unloaded automatically.
REQ-044.destination: ** — Local-model activation shall remain explicit with no automatic load, unload, switch, alias, or fallback; residency transitions shall remain evidence-bearing and epoch-bound, and unknown helper models shall not be unloaded automatically. Boundary-owner allocation: CLM-006.

REQ-046.source: ** — Project-specific tools and deterministic acts shall remain owned by their project or domain adapters and shall not acquire or transfer authority through generic transport.
REQ-046.destination: ** — Project-specific tools and deterministic acts shall remain owned by their project or domain adapters and shall not acquire or transfer authority through generic transport. Boundary-owner allocation: CLM-006.

REQ-047.source: ** — No tranche under this contract shall silently authorize automatic model scheduling, multiple simultaneous primary local models, local Agent 1, piping execution, silent adapter fallback, remote oMLX, credential entry through an unauthorized CLI surface, production PEC mutation, or release, publication, or issuance.
REQ-047.destination: ** — No tranche under this contract shall silently authorize automatic model scheduling, multiple simultaneous primary local models, local Agent 1, piping execution, silent adapter fallback, remote oMLX, credential entry through an unauthorized CLI surface, production PEC mutation, or release, publication, or issuance. Boundary-owner allocation: CLM-006.

REQ-048.source: ** — A Root client and CLI conformance matrix shall prove that client configuration, project access, and daemon credential readiness are not conflated with transport absence; registration and authorization remain distinct; mismatch stops before consequential work; no TCP, alternate daemon, downgrade, alternate model, or automatic replay occurs; and every retained local-only command, exact exit behavior, and exact machine-readable behavior is individually accepted.
REQ-048.destination: ** — A runtime-project client and CLI conformance matrix shall prove that client configuration, project access, and daemon credential readiness are not conflated with transport absence; registration and authorization remain distinct; mismatch stops before consequential work; no TCP, alternate daemon, downgrade, alternate model, or automatic replay occurs; and every retained local-only command, exact exit behavior, and exact machine-readable behavior is individually accepted.

REQ-050.source: ** — If PEC v2 later becomes actually affected, its matrix shall prove that every applicable condition stops the exact operation, no independent PEC runtime loop starts, failed work does not silently mutate accepted PEC truth, PEC optionality does not become a Root correctness dependency, and retained functions derive from current v2 authority rather than frozen v0.4.
REQ-050.destination: ** — If PEC v2 later becomes actually affected, its matrix shall prove that every applicable condition stops the exact operation, no independent PEC runtime loop starts, failed work does not silently mutate accepted PEC truth, PEC optionality does not become a Root correctness dependency, and retained functions derive from current v2 authority rather than frozen v0.4. Boundary-owner allocation: CLM-006.

REQ-051.source: ** — The accepted deliverable-local dependency surface currently declares no upstream or downstream edge. Later gate prerequisites in this contract shall not become dependency truth unless separately added through the owning dependency workflow.
REQ-051.destination: ** — The inherited Root deliverable-local dependency surface at its source basis declares no upstream or downstream edge. Later gate prerequisites in this contract shall not become dependency truth unless separately added through the owning dependency workflow.

CLM-001.source: ** — `SOW-104` assigns consequential generic-runtime semantics to a Root-owned standing carrier with a declared runtime write locus and requires preservation of D-GOV-20 boundaries, versioned-contract evidence, affected-client conformance or migration, proportionate regression evidence, accountable-human release disposition, and no ownership transfer to App, PEC, or another client.
CLM-001.destination: ** — `SOW-104` assigns consequential generic-runtime semantics to a runtime-project-owned standing carrier with a declared runtime write locus and requires preservation of D-GOV-20 boundaries, versioned-contract evidence, affected-client conformance or migration, proportionate regression evidence, accountable-human release disposition, and no ownership transfer to App, PEC, or another client.

CLM-002.source: ** — D-GOV-20 makes root `runtime/` the generic executable runtime workspace and gives one opt-in per-user daemon exclusive ownership of engines, credentials, sessions, delegation, tools, turn locks, interruption, and local-model residency while checkout-contained files retain project authority.
CLM-002.destination: ** — D-GOV-20 establishes the generic executable runtime boundary; the approved ownership overlay locates its workspace at `projects/chirality-runtime/` and gives one opt-in per-user daemon exclusive ownership of engines, credentials, sessions, delegation, tools, turn locks, interruption, and local-model residency while checkout-contained files retain project authority.

CLM-005.source: ** — At the accepted repository basis, this deliverable's `_STATUS.md` is `OPEN`, its live `ScopeOfWork.md` is absent, and its anticipated write locus is a planning note rather than authorization.
CLM-005.destination: ** — At the inherited Root repository basis, that source deliverable's `_STATUS.md` is `OPEN`, its live `ScopeOfWork.md` is absent, and its anticipated write locus is a planning note rather than authorization.

OUT-002.source: ** — Versioned compatibility-contract candidate: an exact Root-owned compatibility identity, grammar, declaration and comparison point, mismatch result, epoch-change criteria, and binding record, or an explicit no-change record.
OUT-002.destination: ** — Versioned compatibility-contract candidate: an exact runtime-project-owned compatibility identity, grammar, declaration and comparison point, mismatch result, epoch-change criteria, and binding record, or an explicit no-change record.

OUT-004.source: ** — Actual affected-client census and boundary matrix: evidence for which accepted clients have an implementation or migration obligation for the exact Root change, which are not affected, and which remain unresolved.
OUT-004.destination: ** — Actual affected-client census and boundary matrix: evidence for which accepted clients have an implementation or migration obligation for the exact runtime-project change, which are not affected, and which remain unresolved.

OUT-006.source: ** — Proportionate Root regression and semantic-evidence bundle: requirement-to-verification traceability, positive and negative cases, absence-of-fallback evidence, source/release bindings, and validation results.
OUT-006.destination: ** — Proportionate runtime-project regression and semantic-evidence bundle: requirement-to-verification traceability, positive and negative cases, absence-of-fallback evidence, source/release bindings, and validation results.

VER-013.source: ** — Compare every Root contract and activation candidate against all ten D-GOV-20 architecture statements, the local-residency boundary, preserved-authority clauses, explicit exclusions, and implementation gates, and return any deviation rather than infer a waiver.
VER-013.destination: ** — Compare every runtime-project contract and activation candidate against all ten D-GOV-20 architecture statements, the local-residency boundary, preserved-authority clauses, explicit exclusions, and implementation gates, and return any deviation rather than infer a waiver.

VER-014.source: ** — For an evidence-proven actually affected Root CLI, App, or PEC operation, run its separately accepted proof matrix and require every client-specific distinction, retained-function claim, no-resend property, optionality boundary, and ownership partition stated in this contract.
VER-014.destination: ** — For an evidence-proven actually affected runtime-project CLI, App, or PEC operation, run its separately accepted proof matrix and require every client-specific distinction, retained-function claim, no-resend property, optionality boundary, and ownership partition stated in this contract.

VER-015.source: ** — At the accepted basis and before the first activation, verify that no Root-local `software-workflow.json` exists, `_DEPENDENCIES.md` declares no edges, child forms are bounded ephemeral Agent 2 generalists, and no registered software check or implementation command is present in any brief.
VER-015.destination: ** — At the accepted basis and before the first activation, verify the inherited Root basis had no Root-local `software-workflow.json` and declared no edges, reconcile the six approved destination evidence inputs without inferring new edges, child forms are bounded ephemeral Agent 2 generalists, and no registered software check or implementation command is present in any brief.

AC-002.source: ** — The compatibility-contract candidate satisfies every Root identity constraint in this contract, answers only fields explicitly accepted by a later gate, and proves rejection before consequential work for mismatch.
AC-002.destination: ** — The compatibility-contract candidate satisfies every generic runtime identity constraint in this contract, answers only fields explicitly accepted by a later gate, and proves rejection before consequential work for mismatch.

AC-006.destination: ** — The runtime-project evidence bundle maps every applicable requirement to positive, negative, and adversarial evidence, identifies evidence owner and basis, and reports all failures without weakening the criterion.

AC-010.destination: ** — No candidate, activation, tool, test, or implementation changes `_STATUS.md`, activates the deliverable, writes `projects/chirality-runtime/`, changes App, PEC, Piping, or Tier-0, repins a contract, or performs a release without the exact later gate that owns that effect.

AC-014.destination: ** — The runtime-project contract and every activation preserve all D-GOV-20 architecture, residency, authority, adapter-ownership, actual-model-attribution, exclusion, and implementation-gate boundaries, with every deviation returned for an exact owner ruling.
